selected.bruce-grobbelaar: Long-serving goalkeeper across six league titles, Rome 1984 and the first double, whose career needs a careful full account.
selected.steve-nicol: Versatile cornerstone of four championship teams and the 1989 Footballer of the Year, bridging several Liverpool eras.
selected.roy-evans: Boot Room coach and manager whose decades at Liverpool connect the dynasty to the rebuilding of the 1990s.
selected.luis-suarez: Transformative forward and central figure in the 2013–14 title challenge, requiring both football and disciplinary context.
selected.dirk-kuyt: Durable forward whose tactical reinvention, major European contributions and decisive goals define a strong Liverpool story.
selected.chris-lawler: Prolific defender and long-serving foundation of Shankly’s championship and European-winning sides.
selected.gerry-byrne: Home-grown defender central to Liverpool’s return to the summit and the first FA Cup triumph.
selected.peter-thompson: Influential winger integral to Shankly’s first great team and its renewal, deserving broader treatment than famous forwards alone.
selected.dietmar-hamann: Midfield organiser linking the 2001 treble to Istanbul, with important tactical and career context beyond one final.
selected.gary-mcallister: Late-career signing whose influence and decisive contributions shaped the extraordinary 2000–01 season.
